WHAT THE HUMAN TAUGHT US

Ten puzzles · one connected planning method

Picture the desired result → name the obstruction → try a forcing transformation → update the relevant defenses → collect or change to the endgame objective.

Keep one to three useful ideas and checked conditionals in attention. A near-complete pattern earns investigation; it is not already proved. The prose below records the human’s ideas. Current measured status is shown on each puzzle; seven now solve autonomously and three remain unresolved.

Human-inspired card idea: Prepare a blocked conversion with a forcing action; preserve its named obstacle.
